# BurstGPT v2.0 earlier request trace

- Publisher: [BurstGPT authors' official repository](https://github.com/HPMLL/BurstGPT/tree/7eb2c4f8350f8a6985272386f5c14af1f678b299) and [v2.0 release](https://github.com/HPMLL/BurstGPT/releases/tag/v2.0). Release tag commit: `7eb2c4f8350f8a6985272386f5c14af1f678b299`. Downloaded and verified on 2026-09-28.
- `BurstGPT_1.csv`: [release asset](https://github.com/HPMLL/BurstGPT/releases/download/v2.0/BurstGPT_1.csv), 52,283,111 bytes, SHA256 `4bb3783693d0a435686fbfc885615d2349bd067239079fa4b749f2e679e12122`. The official release API and local byte digest agree.
- `BurstGPT_2.csv`: [release asset](https://github.com/HPMLL/BurstGPT/releases/download/v2.0/BurstGPT_2.csv), 144,819,209 bytes, SHA256 `44bf5942b03fca42c01a226a545ad3a750ec62688faecd67b6831c56a8928bf7`. The official release API and local byte digest agree.
- Metadata query: `https://api.github.com/repos/HPMLL/BurstGPT/releases/tags/v2.0` (asset `size` and `digest` fields).
- License: [CC BY 4.0 in the authors' repository](https://github.com/HPMLL/BurstGPT/blob/7eb2c4f8350f8a6985272386f5c14af1f678b299/LICENSE). Cite the authors' [BurstGPT paper](https://doi.org/10.1145/3711896.3737413) when using the trace.

These are unmodified source files. They contain `Timestamp`, `Model`, `Request tokens`, `Response tokens`, `Total tokens`, and `Log Type`. Timestamps are relative seconds from the trace's first day. Files 1 and 2 cover relative days 0–60 and 61–120 respectively. They have no elapsed-time, completion timestamp, status, session, VM, GPU, or application SLO columns. `Response tokens` is known only after an outcome; it is never a request-time feature.
